shadows.name: ambient-overlay
shadows.purpose: Drawers, toasts, and floating actions only.

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:6px;color:var(--muted,#5f6963);font:700 12px 'DM Sans',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-field input{height:44px;border:1px solid var(--line,#d9ded9);border-radius:8px;background:var(--paper,#fff);color:var(--ink,#19201d);padding:0 12px;font-size:16px}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#315f48);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Ready Status
components.description: Semantic fleet status with text and shape.

narrative.overview: FireOps pairs field-ready density with calm administrative structure. Interface reads like maintained operations equipment: dark command navigation, pale work surfaces, explicit status language, and restrained ember accents reserved for actions and wayfinding.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral canvas with crisp paper work areas.
Dark green-black navigation establishes command context.
Ember marks primary actions; semantic colors mark operational state.
Compact lists preserve high information density without table rigidity.

rules.name: The Ember Rarity Rule
rules.body: Ember identifies action or location. It is not decoration.

rules.name: The Red Means Blocked Rule
rules.body: Danger red is reserved for errors, critical conditions, and unavailable equipment.

rules.name: The Operational Minimum Rule
rules.body: Mobile controls use at least 16px input text. Secondary interface text never replaces required operational facts.

rules.name: The Flat Work Surface Rule
rules.body: Lists and cards remain flat at rest. Shadows indicate elevation, not decoration.

dos: Do reserve ember for primary actions, focus, and wayfinding.
Do keep status text visible alongside semantic color.
Do preserve operational issue counts at every viewport.
Do use bordered paper surfaces for dense work areas.
donts: Don't hide task-critical metadata to make mobile layouts fit.
Don't use shadows on every card.
Don't introduce new literal colors when a semantic token exists.
Don't use animation without state, feedback, or spatial meaning.
